'''2001 Australasian Continental Championship Chris Morris HuntDown Australian Conties Hero''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Chris Morris]] posted on DeckTech after finishing 12th at [[2001 Australasian Continental Championship]].<ref name="dt-18214">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/18214 HuntDown  Australian Conties Hero], DeckTech (chris "Austin316" morris, 10 August 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/18214/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/18214/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Chris Morris]]
* '''Event:''' [[2001 Australasian Continental Championship]]
* '''Finish:''' 12th
* '''Published:''' 10 August 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''HuntDown  Australian Conties Hero''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif|label=Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTat HD Morris DS 2001 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' This deck went 5 and 1 over the 2 day and is the reason i qualified for day 2 and the reason i came 12th over all

== Original post ==

'''HuntDown  Australian Conties Hero'''
* '''Author:''' chris "Austin316" morris
* '''Published:''' August 10, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' This deck went 5 and 1 over the 2 day and is the reason i qualified for day 2 and the reason i came 12th over all

=== Strategy ===

This deck is so versatile and works a treat

just play it how you want react to your oponent

or play your own game either way u will win

the only loss was to a WYS but my startin hand was all red and my system  but i put up a good fight and it was the last game of day 2 and i had a horrid day and it was a really @#$%ed up tornie but @#$% happens met some good people from sydney eg jarred lisa ting and some cool melb players anyways try it an u will not underestimate the power of this dark side
